title: 输出字符串
problem_statement_md:
编写程序输出下面一句话：

**"Stay hungry, stay foolish" by Steve Jobs**
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Strings[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The man, the legend, Steve Jobs said a lot of cool stuff. Write a program to output his most famous quote in the following format:
[b]"Stay hungry, stay foolish" by Steve Jobs
 [/b]
[note]The output needs to include the double quotes and be exactly in the format shown above.[/note]
hint_md:
1. 输出需要包括双引号，并且完全按照上面的格式。
2. 注意空格需要正确

code_templates.solution_code: print("\"Stay hungry, stay foolish\" by Steve Jobs")
